# Shutdown & Recovery

Use these pages for controlled shutdown and return-to-service of the tool. Each page follows its source procedure and gives the check order and end-state.

  • Planned Shutdown — controlled shutdown for a planned power outage (day-before GFIS warm-up, valve/pump order, chase/UPS/Sogevac steps).
  • Power-Up — facilities, electronics, vacuum pumpdown and release gates after power restoration.
  • GFIS Recovery — bake → anneal → trimer sequence after UHV loss.

Return-to-service after an unplanned vacuum event may also reference the troubleshooting pages.
